title: PS5 Price in Singapore (2026) — Slim, Digital, Disc & Pro live prices
description: Current PS5 price in Singapore for every model: PS5 Slim disc, Digital Edition, older bundles and PS5 Pro. Live prices from Amazon.sg, Shopee, Lazada and local game stores, with model-by-model buying advice and warranty guidance.
heroTitle: PS5 Price in Singapore (2026) — live prices for every model
heroTitleTemplate: PS5 Price in Singapore (2026) — from {floorPrice} today
heroBody: The PlayStation 5 is widely available in Singapore in 2026, but the price you pay depends heavily on which model you choose and where you buy it. Sony's official line-up now includes the PS5 Slim disc console, the smaller Digital Edition and the more powerful PS5 Pro, while authorised retailers and marketplace sellers still clear older bundle stock at varying discounts. This page tracks live PS5 prices in Singapore dollars across Amazon.sg, Shopee, Lazada and local game stores so you can see the current cost of each model, understand what is included and avoid paying for a bundle you do not need.

highlightSectionTitle: What shapes the PS5 price you see in Singapore

highlights.title: The Digital Edition is not always the cheapest long-term choice
highlights.body: The PS5 Digital Edition lists lower than the disc model, but Singapore shoppers who buy used discs, borrow games or shop physical sales can save more over the life of the console with the disc version. Factor your own buying habit, not just the launch price.

highlights.title: Bundles hide or reveal value depending on what is inside
highlights.body: Retailers bundle the PS5 with an extra DualSense controller, a charging dock or a launch-era game. A bundle is worth it only if the included item is on your list. Unwanted games and third-party accessories should be treated as zero value when comparing.

highlights.title: PS5 Pro is a niche upgrade, not a replacement
highlights.body: The Pro delivers better ray-tracing performance and PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution for sharper 4K output on compatible displays. For a 1080p TV or casual player the difference is invisible; it only makes sense if you already own or plan to buy a high-refresh 4K screen.

highlights.title: Warranty wording matters on marketplace listings
highlights.body: A local Singapore set with Sony warranty is easier to service than a parallel import or region-stock unit. Marketplace listings sometimes use vague phrasing; if the listing does not clearly state local Sony warranty, assume it is not covered by Sony Singapore.

adviceSectionTitle: How to read the live PS5 prices and pay the right amount
advicePoints: Start by choosing the model, not the price. The Digital Edition looks cheaper but only saves money if you never buy physical games. The disc Slim is the safer default for most Singapore households.
Compare bundle contents against the console-only floor. An extra controller is useful; an unwanted three-year-old game is not. Subtract the value of items you would not have bought anyway.
Look for local-set or Sony Singapore warranty on the listing. The peace of mind is worth a small premium on a console you will keep for years.
Time non-urgent purchases around Shopee and Lazada campaigns. Console vouchers and bank promos stack best during 9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12 and year-end sales.
Be sceptical of listings well below the live market floor. Stolen photos, pre-order wording on in-stock items and no-return sellers are common warning signs.
If you already own a launch PS5, neither the Slim nor the Pro is a must-upgrade. Spend the money on storage, games or a better TV instead.
faqSectionTitle: PS5 price in Singapore — common questions

faqs.question: How much does a PS5 cost in Singapore in 2026?
faqs.answer: The live cards above show today's Singapore prices for each model. The Digital Edition is usually the cheapest official model, the Slim disc sits in the middle and the PS5 Pro is the most expensive. Bundles and parallel imports can move prices above or below these bands.

faqs.question: Is the PS5 Pro worth the extra cost in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Only if you play on a 4K 120 Hz display and want the best ray-tracing and upscaling performance. For 1080p TVs or casual play the Slim or Digital Edition is the better value.

faqs.question: Should I buy a PS5 bundle or console only in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Buy a bundle only if it includes an item you already planned to purchase, such as an extra DualSense controller or a game on your list. Otherwise compare the console-only price and buy accessories separately.

faqs.question: Do parallel-import PS5 consoles have Sony warranty in Singapore?
faqs.answer: No. Sony Singapore generally honours warranty only on local sets sold through authorised retailers. Parallel imports carry the seller's own warranty, which is why they are cheaper.

faqs.question: When is the PS5 cheapest in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Platform sale events on Shopee and Lazada such as 9.9, 11.11 and 12.12, plus year-end shopping periods, are when console vouchers and bank promos usually stack deepest.

categoryIntro.heading: Why PS5 prices vary more by seller than by model
categoryIntro.body: In Singapore the official Sony and authorised game retailer prices are fairly predictable, but marketplace sellers move faster with vouchers, bundles and bank promotions. The same PS5 Slim disc console can appear at very different prices depending on whether it is sold as a bare unit, a holiday bundle or a parallel import. This page pulls live listings from Amazon.sg, Shopee, Lazada and local game stores so you can see the current spread rather than a single outdated number.
